newsitem.title: UK: Greycoat faces break-up call - newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Greycoat faces break-up call - newspaper.

text.p: UK Active Value Fund, the second largest investor in Greycoat Plc , will call on Monday for the property company to break up its 500 million stg porfolio, The Sunday Times reported.
"Brian Myerson and Julian Treger, the two entrepreneurs who run UK Active, believe that Greycoat's management, headed by Peter Thornton, its managing director, is ineffective," the newspaper said.
UK Active, which holds an 11 percent stake in the company, is to call for a shareholders meeting so it can put its proposal to a vote, the newspaper said.

Greycoat's biggest asset is Embankment Place above London's Charing Cross staion, the newspaper said. The company has about 60 million stg of equity invested in the property , which is worth more than 200 million stg, the newspaper said.
Greycoat was not available for comment.
